shortDescription: Manage provisioners on a C(step-ca) server

options.name: admin_cert
options.description: Admin certificate (chain) in PEM format to store in the 'x5c' header of a JWT.

options.name: admin_key
options.description: Private key file, used to sign a JWT,corresponding to the admin certificate that will be stored in the 'x5c' header.

options.name: admin_password_file
options.description: The path to the file containing the password to encrypt or decrypt the private key.

options.name: admin_provisioner
options.description: The provisioner name to use for generating admin credentials.

options.name: admin_subject
options.description: The admin subject to use for generating admin credentials.

options.name: allow_renewal_after_expiry
options.description: Allow renewals for expired certificates generated by this provisioner.

options.name: aws_accounts
options.description: The AWS account ids used to validate the identity documents. Must be a list

options.name: azure_audience
options.description: The Microsoft Azure audience name used to validate the identity tokens.

options.name: azure_object_ids
options.description: The Microsoft Azure AD object ids used to validate the identity tokens. Must be a list

options.name: azure_resource_groups
options.description: The Microsoft Azure resource group names used to validate the identity tokens. Must be a list

options.name: azure_subscription_ids
options.description: The Microsoft Azure subscription ids used to validate the identity tokens. Must be a list

options.name: azure_tenant
options.description: The Microsoft Azure tenant id used to validate the identity tokens.

options.name: ca_config
options.description: The path to the certificate authority configuration file on the host if managing provisioners locally.

options.name: ca_url
options.description: URI of the targeted Step Certificate Authority

options.name: disable_custom_sans
options.description: On cloud provisioners, if enabled only the internal DNS and IP will be added as a SAN. By default it will accept any SAN in the CSR.

options.name: disable_renewal
options.description: Disable renewal for all certificates generated by this provisioner.

options.name: disable_trust_on_first_use
options.description: On cloud provisioners, if enabled multiple sign request for this provisioner with the same instance will be accepted. By default only the first request will be accepted.

options.name: force_cn
options.description: Always set the common name in provisioned certificates.

options.name: gcp_projects
options.description: The Google project ids used to validate the identity tokens. Must be a list

options.name: gcp_service_accounts
options.description: The Google service account emails or ids used to validate the identity tokens. Must be a list

options.name: instance_age
options.description: The maximum duration to grant a certificate in AWS and GCP provisioners. A duration is sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: jwk_create
options.description: Create the JWK key pair for the provisioner.

options.name: jwk_private_key
options.description: The file containing the JWK private key.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the provisioner to add/remove.

options.name: nebula_root
options.description: Root certificate (chain) file used to validate the signature on Nebula provisioning tokens.

options.name: oidc_admins
options.description: The emails of admin users in an OpenID Connect provisioner, these users will not have restrictions in the certificates to sign. Must be a list

options.name: oidc_client_id
options.description: The id used to validate the audience in an OpenID Connect token.

options.name: oidc_client_secret
options.description: The secret used to obtain the OpenID Connect tokens.

options.name: oidc_configuration_endpoint
options.description: OpenID Connect configuration url.

options.name: oidc_groups
options.description: The group list used to validate the groups extenstion in an OpenID Connect token. Must be a list

options.name: oidc_listen_address
options.description: The callback address used in the OpenID Connect flow (e.g. ":10000").

options.name: oidc_tenant_id
options.description: The tenant-id used to replace the templatized {tenantid} in the OpenID Configuration.

options.name: password_file
options.description: The path to the file containing the password to encrypt or decrypt the private key.

options.name: public_key
options.description: The file containing the JWK public key. Or, a file containing one or more PEM formatted keys, if used with the K8SSA provisioner.

options.name: require_eab
options.description: Require (and enable) External Account Binding (EAB) for Account creation. If this flag is set to false, then disable EAB.

options.name: root
options.description: The path to the PEM file used as the root certificate authority.

options.name: scep_capabilities
options.description: The SCEP capabilities to advertise

options.name: scep_challenge
options.description: The SCEP challenge to use as a shared secret between a client and the CA

options.name: scep_encryption_algorithm_identifier
options.description: The id for the SCEP encryption algorithm to use. Valid values are 0 - 4, inclusive. The values correspond to: 0: DES-CBC, 1: AES-128-CBC, 2: AES-256-CBC, 3: AES-128-GCM, 4: AES-256-GCM. Defaults to DES-CBC (0) for legacy clients.

options.name: scep_include_root
options.description: Include the CA root certificate in the SCEP CA certificate chain.

options.name: scep_min_public_key_length
options.description: The minimum public key length of the SCEP RSA encryption key

options.name: ssh
options.description: Enable provisioning of ssh certificates. The default value is true. To disable ssh use '--ssh=false'.

options.name: ssh_host_default_dur
options.description: The default duration for an ssh host certificate generated by this provisioner. Value must be a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction, and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: ssh_host_max_dur
options.description: The maximum duration for an ssh host certificate generated by this provisioner. Value must be a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction, and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: ssh_host_min_dur
options.description: The minimum duration for an ssh host certificate generated by this provisioner. Value must be a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction, and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: ssh_template
options.description: The ssh certificate template file, a JSON representation of the certificate to create.

options.name: ssh_template_data
options.description: The ssh certificate template data file, a JSON map of data that can be used by the certificate template.

options.name: ssh_user_default_dur
options.description: The default duration for an ssh user certificate generated by this provisioner. Value must be a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction, and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: ssh_user_max_dur
options.description: The maximum duration for an ssh user certificate generated by this provisioner. Value must be a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction, and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: ssh_user_min_dur
options.description: The minimum duration for an ssh user certificate generated by this provisioner. Value must be a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction, and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the provisioner should be present or absent. Note that C(present) does not update existing provisioners. C(updated) will attempt to update the provisioner regardless of whether it has changed or not. Note that this will always report the task as changed.

options.name: step_cli_executable
options.description: Name (or absolute path) of the C(step-cli) executable to use

options.name: type
options.description: The type of provisioner to create (case-sensitive). Ignored when state == absent or updated. Required if state == present

options.name: x509_default_dur
options.description: The default duration for an x509 certificate generated by this provisioner. Value must be a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction, and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: x509_max_dur
options.description: The maximum duration for an x509 certificate generated by this provisioner. Value must be a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction, and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: x509_min_dur
options.description: The minimum duration for an x509 certificate generated by this provisioner. Value must be a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction, and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

options.name: x509_template
options.description: The x509 certificate template file, a JSON representation of the certificate to create.

options.name: x509_template_data
options.description: The x509 certificate template data file, a JSON map of data that can be used by the certificate template.

options.name: x5c_root
options.description: Root certificate (chain) file used to validate the signature on X5C provisioning tokens.
